name: Belal Muhammad
profileSummary: Belal Muhammad is an American professional mixed martial artist who currently competes in the Welterweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where he is a former UFC Welterweight Champion. As of June 9, 2026, he is #7 in the Meta UFC welterweight rankings. A professional since 2012, he has also competed for Bellator and Titan FC. Muhammad is the first Arab mixed martial artist to win a UFC championship.
